title: MegNIST, A Benchmark for Non-Invasive Inner Speech Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.21399v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: MegNIST is a benchmark dataset for developing and evaluating machine learning methods for inner speech decoding from magnetoencephalography (MEG). The dataset comprises 12,000 trials of a single participant imagining speaking the digits zero through nine, recorded across four sessions. Each trial contains 306-channel MEG recordings sampled at 250 Hz, preprocessed using signal space separation, filtering, and downsampling. Data are provided as pre-defined training (10,000 trials), validation (1,000 trials), and test (1,000 trials) splits, with entire experimental runs assigned to each split to preserve temporal independence. The dataset is available in both BIDS format for neuroimaging analysis and as serialised tensors for machine learning workflows. translated_title: MegNIST：非侵入式内部语音解码的基准数据集
translated_abstract: MegNIST是一个用于开发和评估基于脑磁图（MEG）的内部语音解码机器学习方法的基准数据集。该数据集包含单一参与者想象说出数字零至九的12,000次试验，横跨四个会话记录。每次试验包含以250 Hz采样的306通道MEG记录，并经过信号空间分离、滤波和降采样等预处理。数据以预定义的训练集（10,000次试验）、验证集（1,000次试验）和测试集（1,000次试验）划分提供，每个划分按完整的实验运行进行分配以保持时间独立性。该数据集同时提供适用于神经成像分析的BIDS格式和适用于机器学习工作流的序列化张量格式。基线分类结果表明，想象说出的数字可以以显著高于随机水平的准确率被解码。该数据集还提供标准化的数据划分、经过验证的基线模型、示例代码以及PyTorch兼容的加载工具。
tldr: MegNIST提供了首个用于脑磁图（MEG）非侵入式内部语音解码的标准化基准数据集，包含12,000次想象说数字的试验数据、预定义的数据划分和验证过的基线结果，可加速该领域的机器学习方法研发。
en_tdlr: MegNIST introduces a standardized benchmark dataset for non-invasive inner speech decoding from MEG, comprising 12,000 trials of imagined digit speech with predefined data splits and validated baselines to accelerate machine learning research in this field.
